# hexcore_regions (Data Source)

Read the HexCore regions catalog. Results are ordered by slug, then ID where available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hexcore_regions" "available" {}

output "regions" {
  value = data.hexcore_regions.available.regions
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) Catalog entries in stable order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

<a id="nestedatt--regions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `regions`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether the region currently accepts creation. Unavailable regions remain visible.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Catalog slug.
